title: Ben Zaza
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: (“And of the sons of Yonatan: Pelet and Zaza,” I Chronicles 20:33.) He is mentioned in Rosh Hashanah 25a: when Ben Zaza’s mother died, Rabban Gamliel delivered a great eulogy for her — not because she deserved it, but so that the people would know that the court had not sanctified the month.

notes.text: The supplied locator is I Chronicles 20:33. The matching named Miqra text is I Chronicles 2:33, listing Pelet and Zaza. Both the supplied locator and the matching location are retained; no printed correction history is established.
